sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup for the Tasks page
sections.what: Brings in the page icons, the task types, the shared store, the button, the task views, the create window, the bulk actions bar and the calendar view.
sections.why: Likely reason: this page is the hub for everything about tasks, so it gathers the parts it displays.
sections.watch_out: Renaming any of these component files breaks this page, because each import uses the file path.

sections.name: TasksView (part 1)
sections.title: Page settings and bucket filter
sections.what: Holds the page settings: the chosen bucket, the view, search text, priority and energy filters, sort choice, and the selected tasks. Keeps only the tasks in the chosen bucket. The board view keeps completed tasks too, so cards can be moved between all columns.
sections.why: Likely reason: the board needs every status visible, so dragging a card between columns keeps it on screen.
sections.watch_out: Today is worked out from the UTC date, so a user far from UTC can see the wrong day's tasks near midnight.

sections.name: TasksView: if
sections.title: Energy filter, sorting and bucket buttons
sections.what: Narrows the list by energy level, then sorts it by priority, due date, or time estimate. Defines the four bucket buttons and draws them together with the first view button.
sections.why: Likely reason: sorting lets the user put the most important work first, and the bucket buttons give quick preset groups.
sections.watch_out: The due date sort gives the same answer for two equal dates, so the order among tasks with the same date is not dependable.

sections.name: TasksView (part 3)
sections.title: View buttons, New Task and search
sections.what: Draws the board, timeline, calendar and table view buttons, the New Task button that opens the create window, and the search box.
sections.why: Likely reason: the view buttons sit together so the user can switch how tasks are shown in one place.
sections.watch_out: Switching views does not reset search or filters, so a hidden filter can keep tasks out of the new view without any notice.

sections.name: TasksView (part 4)
sections.title: Priority, energy and sort dropdowns
sections.what: Draws the priority, energy and sort dropdowns beside the search box.
sections.why: Likely reason: all narrowing controls sit in one row so the user can combine them.
sections.watch_out: The sort dropdown value is cast without being checked, so an unexpected value falls through to the time estimate sort.

sections.name: TasksView (part 5)
sections.title: Main view area and bulk bar
sections.what: Shows the chosen view: board, timeline, calendar, table, or the default list. Also shows the floating bulk actions bar for selected tasks and the create window.
sections.why: Likely reason: one switch decides what the main area shows, so only one view is drawn at a time.
sections.watch_out: Selected task ids are not cleared when filters or views change, so the bulk bar can act on tasks the user can no longer see.

summary: The main Tasks page, where the user narrows, sorts, and switches between list, board, timeline, calendar and table views of their tasks.
purpose: Give the user one place to find, filter, arrange and act on tasks.
why: Likely reason: all page controls and their saved choices are kept in one screen so the views stay in step.
how: 1. Reads all tasks from the store. 2. Keeps only the tasks in the chosen bucket. 3. Applies search, priority and energy filters. 4. Sorts the result. 5. Draws the bucket buttons, view buttons, search box and filter dropdowns. 6. Shows the chosen view. 7. Shows the bulk actions bar and the create window.
inputs: The task list from the shared store, plus the user's choices in the buttons, search box and dropdowns.
outputs: The page on screen with the chosen tasks in the chosen view. The selected task ids are shared with the bulk actions bar and the table.
risks: Selected tasks are not cleared when filters or views change, so bulk actions may affect hidden tasks. Today is worked out from the UTC date, so near midnight the wrong day can show. The calendar view ignores the filters.
debug: If a task is missing, check the bucket and filter choices first, then the task's due date format. If Today's Focus looks wrong, check the time zone used for the date. If bulk actions touch hidden tasks, check how the selected list is cleared. Reset all filters to see if a filter is hiding the tasks.
